message:
fix(tsconfig): include .storybook/** — dot-dirs are skipped by include globs

TypeScript's include glob matching doesn't descend into dot-directories
by default, so `**/*.tsx` silently excluded .storybook/preview.tsx (and
its siblings) from the configured project. VS Code fell back to an
inferred project for that file, using moduleResolution "Node" instead of
this project's "bundler" — which broke resolution of
@storybook/react-vite's conditional exports and produced a false
ts(2307) despite `bun run typecheck` passing clean.
